prerequisites: Previous knowledge acquired in the subjects Mathematics I and Mathematics II from the basic training module.

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to communicate and social aptitude
Ability for critical and self-critical thinking
Ability to solve mathematical problems that may arise in engineering. Aptitude to apply basic knowledge about statistics
Analyze data from contexts of uncertainty.
Model and solve situations governed by chance, involving the use of probability functions.

syllabus_topics: Data analysis: Unidimensional and bidimensional statistical variables, frequency tables, graphs. Descriptive measures. Marginal and conditional distributions. Statistical independence.

Probability: Counting techniques. Random experiment. Sample space and events. Axioms of probability. Properties. Conditional probability. Product, total, and Bayes' probability rules. Independence of events.
Random variable: Discrete and continuous random variable. Probability distribution. Characteristics of a random variable. Chebyshev's inequality.
Probability models: Binomial, Negative Binomial, Geometric, Poisson, Exponential, Normal.
Statistical inference: Sampling. Statistics and estimators. Point estimation. Confidence interval estimation. Parametric hypothesis tests. Normality tests.
Simple linear regression model: Simple linear regression. Regression tests. Correlation. Predictions.

assessment_methods.method: Continuous assessment (progress tests and/or computer practices)

assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, the final grade is composed of a written final exam (70%) and continuous assessment (30%). A minimum final grade of 5 points out of 10 is required to pass the course. For the unique final evaluation, students will take a written final exam (70%) and a practical exam (30%), also requiring a minimum of 5 points. For the extraordinary call, students can choose to retain their continuous assessment grade or take a practical recovery exam for the 30% component; the written final exam still accounts for 70%. A minimum final grade of 5 points is required to pass in this call.
